Definition: from G2545; properly, a burn (concretely), but used (abstractly) of a glow:--heat.
BiblicalUsage: Kauma means heat, a burning glow. Revelation 7:16 promises the redeemed shall hunger no more, neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat, while Revelation 16:9 says men were scorched with great heat and blasphemed God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same heat that scorches the unrepentant will never touch those sheltered in Christ.
